# TIC Wireless

> TIC Wireless is an independent cell phone store at 3640 Hillcroft St, Houston, TX 77057 (Southwest Houston, near Westpark Tollway and the Mahatma Gandhi District). It sells unlocked iPhones (including iPhone 18 Pro Max) and Android phones with no-credit-needed leasing (lease-to-own) from $40 down, prepaid plans for all major carriers, Xfinity Prepaid internet and accessories, and does same-day phone screen, battery and charging-port repair, plus unlocking, bill payments and international recharge. Phone (713) 339-9300. Open Mon–Sat 9 AM–8 PM, Sun 9 AM–5 PM. Rated 4.7 on Google (400+ reviews). Se habla español.

Key facts:

- Name: TIC Wireless (also "TIC Wireless - Hillcroft")
- Address: 3640 Hillcroft St, Houston, TX 77057, USA (moved from 3838 Hillcroft St, Suite 100)
- Phone: (713) 339-9300
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM–8:00 PM; Sunday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; no appointment needed
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Leasing: no credit needed, bad credit OK, options from $40 down, weekly/biweekly/monthly payments, subject to approval; also on PS5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch 2, MacBook, laptops and iPads
- Carriers (prepaid): Verizon Prepaid, AT&T Prepaid, T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, Cricket, Boost Mobile, Simple Mobile, Lyca Mobile, GoSmart, Gen Mobile; Xfinity Prepaid internet
- Repairs: iPhone, Samsung and Android phones, tablets, laptops and computers; most phone repairs same day; price quoted before work starts
- Areas served: Southwest Houston — Westside/Mid West, Mahatma Gandhi District (Harwin/Hillcroft), Gulfton, Sharpstown, Westchase, Galleria/Uptown, Briarmeadow, Bellaire, Alief
